podcast.body: A 60s pop song covered by The Ramones, originally co-written by Sonny Bono of Sonny & Cher, showcasing the band's appreciation for classic pop material. "Needles and Pins, which was co-written by Sunny Bono, a Sunny In Share."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The Ramones covered "Needles and Pins," and their version inspired Seymour Stein of Sire Records to sign The Searchers. "Inspired by the Ramones covering Needles and Pins to sound the searches to a two album deal."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
